working_definition: A small (26 cell) neuropeptide-co-expression subcluster, dominant parent res-2.0 cluster 64 ('Octopaminergic-Tyraminergic'), inferred (not directly stated in the paper) to represent a small octopaminergic (Tbh+) subset additionally expressing the neuropeptide Mip (myoinhibitory peptide), recovered via the same neuropeptide-focused re-clustering strategy used for other co-expression subclusters. Not an established named anatomical cell type; identity and location are not independently confirmed by the authors.
justification: Mip/OCT is one of the authors' named groups from the re-clustering of neuropeptide-expressing cells (Figure 2K), named by its neuropeptide, Mip. FBbt:00047527 'adult myoinhibitory peptide neuron' (any adult neuron that expresses Mip) is the containing class the authors' name supports; broad match because the group is a subset of Mip neurons (co-expressing 'OCT'), not all of them.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Any octopaminergic neuron of the adult.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: The group comes from the authors' re-clustering of neuropeptide-expressing cells and is named for Mip; reading 'OCT' as octopaminergic rests on our inference from where its cells came from.

recommendation: Broad match to FBbt:00047527 adult myoinhibitory peptide neuron.
